article.title: Lung Cancer Detection using Convolutional Neural Network (CNN)

acquisition.route: GeeksforGeeks article -> linked Google Drive folder -> three supplied class ZIP archives
acquisition.date_note: Workspace handoff and archive filename timestamps are not treated as verified Drive download date/time.

upstream_provenance.candidate_upstream_dataset: Lung and Colon Cancer Histopathological Image Dataset (LC25000)
lineage_evidence: The three class names and class-plus-number filename pattern match the official LC25000 repository.
The supplied subset has 800 images per class at 128x128 pixels; official LC25000 documentation describes 5000 images per class at 768x768 pixels.
No source manifest, upstream checksums, or parent-image mapping verifies that the Drive subset was derived from LC25000.
upstream_provenance.candidate_source_note: The paper reports 250 original lung images per class expanded to 5000 per class through augmentation. This is relevant only if the candidate LC25000 lineage is confirmed; this subset has no map to original source images.

checks: No manifest or metadata file in supplied archives/project data.
JPEG files have no EXIF metadata.
Filenames encode class plus numeric sample suffix; the suffix is not documented as a patient, slide, or source-image identifier.

upstream_provenance.status_note: The article-linked acquisition route is team-confirmed. Filename convention suggests LC25000 as a candidate lineage, but the subset source and creator remain unverified.

license.candidate_upstream_paper_availability_st: Describes the dataset as freely available for download to AI researchers; no explicit license grant found.
license.rights_note: The candidate LC25000 connection is unverified and no explicit dataset license was located. Reuse and redistribution rights for this custom subset remain unverified.

archive_audit.audit_note: Archive files were rechecked for provenance on 2026-10-04. Perceptual-hash grouping details are retained from reports/data_audit.json.

rights_note: A Google Drive link establishes the acquisition route but does not establish dataset ownership, license, or permission to redistribute.

identifier_and_split_review.action_if_reliable_ids_become_available: Create a verified data/group_manifest.csv, regenerate the split, retrain both models, select using validation only, and reevaluate on the new held-out test split.
